title: dataset row
description: One row of datainventory.csv as ingested by the population engine. confirmed_exfiltrated is a three-state field (yes/no/uncertain), not a boolean - 'uncertain' rows (e.g. DI-003, DI-006) are the ones pending backup-index reconciliation per evidence-pack.md's board instruction, and are the basis for the lower/upper population split. Jurisdiction 'Other US' is observed in the data (DI-010) but is explicitly out of scope for this project's state-law analysis per evidence-pack.md - it must still be represented (do not silently drop the row on ingest) but should not feed any of the three in-scope jurisdiction populations.

jurisdiction.description: Fixed set observed across all rows. 'Other US' rows are out of scope for jurisdiction population totals - see top-level description.

dataset.description: Observed values: patient_support, account_profile, archived_cases. Not enum-locked - hidden fixtures may introduce new dataset names, and the brief does not guarantee this list is exhaustive.

data_categories.description: Pipe-delimited category tags as stored in the raw CSV, e.g. 'email|mobile|password_hash'. Split on '|' at parse time; this schema validates the raw ingested string, not the parsed array.

overlap_group.description: Groups people represented across more than one dataset within a jurisdiction, e.g. EU-A, NG-B, CA-A, US-A. Per evidence-pack.md: count each overlap_group once per jurisdiction, not once per row.

confirmed_exfiltrated.description: NOT boolean. 'no' (e.g. DI-009, 'network evidence excludes archive') means the row must be EXCLUDED from all population counts per brief.md's 'exclude network-disproved datasets' instruction. 'uncertain' rows count toward the upper bound only.

high_risk_subset.description: Count of subjects within this row meeting the Article 34 / high-risk criterion (diagnosis_category AND id_suffix both present, per evidence-pack.md). Engine-level constraint (not enforceable in JSON Schema alone): must be <= unique_subjects.
